business_problem: Grano Oy needed to replace siloed on-premises data tools with a centralized analytics environment so it could create defined metrics, consistent reporting, and better visibility for sales, manufacturing, and sustainability teams.
solution_summary: Grano Oy built a cloud data management environment on AWS to replace fragmented on-premises analytics tooling and give business teams a shared reporting foundation. Data from source systems is first loaded into Amazon S3 as a staging layer, then transformed and joined in Amazon Redshift, where Grano creates data models and purpose-specific data marts for sales, manufacturing, sustainability, and other internal reporting needs. This architecture centralizes previously siloed data, enforces defined metrics and reporting models, and makes detailed drill-down analysis available to teams that previously lacked a dedicated warehouse or governance strategy. With the AWS-built hub, Grano can forecast sales earlier, investigate root causes of events, support complex sustainability reporting, and lay the groundwork for a broader AI and machine-learning-enabled central data hub.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Acts as the staging layer where Grano loads data from source systems.

solution_components.name: Amazon Redshift
solution_components.role: Transforms, joins, models, and organizes data into marts for Grano's reporting use cases.

data_flow: Data from Grano's source systems is loaded into Amazon S3 as a staging layer, transformed and joined in Amazon Redshift, organized into data models and marts, and then consumed in internal sales, manufacturing, and sustainability reports and dashboards.
business_outcome: Grano improved access to insights, streamlined reporting, enabled earlier sales forecasting and root-cause analysis, increased proactive behavior across the sales organization, and created a central repository that simplifies complex sustainability reporting and future AI initiatives.
architecture_clues: Uses Amazon S3 as a staging layer and Amazon Redshift for transformation, models, and data marts.
Supports internal reporting for sales, sustainability, and manufacturing operations.
Plans to evolve into a centralized data hub for collaboration, ML, and AI services.
